title: GatePrepareApproval
description: Response of prepare (#15 issueNonce, consumed by #32 prepareApproval). Each call issues a new nonce and invalidates the previous one. The response has no challenge: the device builds it from payloadHash, intentId and nonce. The byte encoding is an open question.

payload.description: The stored canonical payload: the JCS string (UTF-8) the card is rendered from and the hash covers.

payloadHash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 the gate computed over the stored canonical payload.

nonce.description: Single-use nonce: 32 random bytes as unpadded base64url.

items.title: GateContextSource
items.description: A linked source shown as Context used.
